research.method: All values come from FIBA's official statistics service behind fiba.basketball (the public data API the site's history pages call). For every team the player list comes from getgdapcompetitionteamstatisticsbyteamid; each player's totals are the sum of his per-game rows from getgdapplayergamestatisticsbyplayerid, restricted to the 40 games of this tournament listed by getgdapgamesbycompetitionid. Birth dates come from getgdapplayerinfobycompetitionid (fallback: the team roster). FIBA records minutes in whole minutes for these events.
research.add_up_check: Each team's summed player points equal the points in its game scores (difference listed per team in team_totals[].check).
research.bbr_matching: bbr_id is set only for keys of library/careers/nba_player_careers.json with an NBA season in 2003-04, 2004-05 or 2005-06, matched by name and then reviewed by hand (birth date and team) for every hand-made match; players whose NBA careers ended before 2003-04 have no careers key and keep bbr_id null (noted on the record).
notes: FIBA files EuroBasket 2005 as one competition (2725) that also holds the 2004-05 qualifying round, the 2005 additional qualifying round, Division B qualification games and the relegation tournament. Only the 40 final-tournament games played 16-25 September 2005 (Preliminary Round, Elimination Games, Quarter Finals, classification, Semi-Finals, placings and Final) are summed here; FIBA's team statistics endpoint for this competition mixes in the qualifiers and is not used for totals.
10 team-games record zero team blocks while other categories are recorded; kept as real zeros (a team can finish a game without a block), not as missing data.
conflicts: Spain's minutes include Rudy Fernandez's rows recorded in seconds (the only non-whole-minute rows) and the Spain v Serbia and Montenegro preliminary game (2005-09-16) sums to only 189.7 Spanish player-minutes: some minutes are missing from that game's FIBA rows. Totals kept as recorded.
research.minutes_reconciliation: FIBA rounds each player's minutes to whole minutes, so a team's game total can be 1-2 minutes off 200 (or 225/250 with overtime). Teams whose totals are off by more than rounding plus whole overtimes: Bulgaria: 628 minutes in 3 games (+28 vs 200 a game); Greece: 1403 minutes in 7 games (+3 vs 200 a game); Israel: 803 minutes in 4 games (+3 vs 200 a game); Spain: 1237.97 minutes in 6 games (+37.97 vs 200 a game)
